name: B10-0086/2024 (The Left) – The democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on events in Georgia before the country's parliamentary elections on 26 October 2024. It criticises two new Georgian laws: one on "family values" that restricts LGBTQ+ rights and media reporting, and one on "foreign influence" that could label groups receiving overseas money as foreign agents. It also raises concerns about force used against protesters and about gender quotas being abolished. It calls for free and fair elections and offers to help observe them.

- The Parliament states its opinion only; no EU law changes and no new rules apply.
- The criticism targets Georgia's government, its new laws, and its treatment of protesters.
- Next: the Parliament offers to join an international election observation mission before the 26 October vote.
